status: OMF Original Bin recommendations awaiting approval; OMF reading/version/text/identity/Clip Name/Project rules are agreed.

proposedBellaRules.scope: Name-only Original Bin from an already-read supported legacy OMF. No runtime code/cutover, Bin Filter change, final source priority or new header-open trigger. MXF Original Bin fallback remains blank.
proposedBellaRules.owner: Use the same selected master as Clip Name/full-ID association; its Clip Name text may be empty. Read only its own exact _ORG_BIN Kind3 object reference, safely resolved to an MCBR bin record.
proposedBellaRules.names: Prefer usable exact binNameUTF8 as strict known UTF-8. Missing/empty/individually unreadable modern name permits the separate binName decoded as MacRoman. Never reinterpret damaged modern bytes as legacy. Preserve characters/spelling/case/punctuation/whitespace with bounded supported string framing.
proposedBellaRules.validation: Require supported reference, owner, target class and string type/representation. Equal repetitions can agree; conflicting usable same-priority values or ambiguous bin references give no usable field. A usable Unicode name outranks a different legacy spelling. General OMF damage boundaries remain later.
proposedBellaRules.unavailable: Keep OMF contribution unavailable and OMF-only table blank when no usable association/name; preserve physical row, master and independent facts. No file/source/nested-import/other-master/loaded-bin/filesystem substitute.
proposedBellaRules.retention: One owned selected QString and necessary compact availability/selected-owner context. Skip stored bin-ID words for this display requirement; release temporary name/reference data. No permanent raw bin object, second spelling, Bin ID or alternate-bin history.
